swayable.summary: A person answers brief questions about whether Congress is handling its work, giving a cautious, mixed answer. The video is a short, conversational clip that feels like a candid street or hallway interview.
swayable.title: Lawmaker Says 'A Lot of Work to Do' After Temporary Deal

traits.change: Have the messenger open with 'As a veteran, I've seen what happens when Congress fails to act' to establish a veteran identity.
Add a line like 'We made some temporary headway, but Republicans are still blocking the real work' to set up a clear before-and-after or us-versus-them contrast.
The script reads like a raw, unpolished grab — add a clean opening title card line and a closing call-to-action line to signal a more produced format.

traits.quote: We made some temporary headway, but we got a lot of work to do still.

Add a line like 'I was in that room when the vote happened and I knew we weren't done' to give the speaker a personal stake in the story.
Add a closing line such as 'Vote for candidates who will finish the job on November 5th' to make a direct ask.

Add a line such as 'The House still needs to pass three more funding bills before the deadline' to ground the video in a concrete fact.
Add a line like 'Republicans walked out before the real work was done' to introduce a negative statement about the opposing side.

Add a light line such as 'Resolved — well, as resolved as Congress ever gets' to bring in a small moment of humor.
Replace the current unnamed speaker with a recognizable public figure and identify them by name at the start of the clip.
Add a line like 'Frankly, I'm angry that we're still here having this conversation' to introduce a clear expression of anger.

Cut 'We made some temporary headway' to remove the only positive claim about progress and replace it with a neutral factual statement.
Add a line naming the specific policy at stake, such as 'This is about keeping TSA funding intact so airports stay safe.'
Cut 'We made some temporary headway' to remove the only upbeat note and leave only the cautious, unresolved tone.
